name: AfterQuery
work: Expert contract work: writing realistic scenarios and reference answers for AI evaluations, and grading AI output in your professional field.

source.title: RemoWork: how AI training platforms pay (AfterQuery Stripe payout to Kenya)

availability.note: AfterQuery publishes no country list we could find. A reviewer documented being paid in Kenya, and a worker in Kenya was able to open an account. Some listings are limited to specific countries such as the United States. Other African countries are unclear.

items.text: Contributors work as independent contractors, not employees, and pay is tied to the quality and quantity of completed work.
Listings ask for fluent written and spoken English and a reliable internet connection. Some are limited to one country.
Applications are reviewed against a rubric. You may be asked to take a written assessment, then you sign a contractor agreement, connect Stripe and are matched to work, usually within a week.
Payouts go through Stripe. A reviewer documented Stripe payouts to Kenya.
